NV-2027-SB3.title: Revises provisions relating to emergency management. (BDR 36-161)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Government Affairs. To printer.

NV-2027-SB3.description: AN ACT relating to emergency management; revising the duties of the Chief of the Office of Emergency Management in the Office of the Governor; revising the duties of the State Disaster Identification Coordination Committee within the Office of Emergency Management; revising provisions governing the appointment of members of the Nevada Resilience Advisory Committee; transferring certain duties of the Board of Search and Rescue and the Intrastate Mutual Aid Committee to the Nevada Resilience Advisory Committee; eliminating the Board of Search and Rescue and the Intrastate Mutual Aid Committee; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB3.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB3.aiSummary: The bill would revise some state emergency management duties in Nevada. It would change the duties of the Chief of the Office of Emergency Management and the State Disaster Identification Coordination Committee, and it would change how members are appointed to the Nevada Resilience Advisory Committee. It would also move some duties to that committee and eliminate the Board of Search and Rescue and the Intrastate Mutual Aid Committee.
